notes: Continuing operations are commercial foodservice only: Midera (food processing) was spun off in July 2026 (Yahoo price adjustment factor 1.243 on 2026-07-07), 51% of Residential Kitchen was sold for $564.6M net of cash (49% kept as an equity-method investment, $73.4M, plus an $84.1M note receivable), and the Brewing businesses are being closed by year end.

Q3 2026: net sales $652.6M (+7.7%, all organic); adjusted EBITDA $155.8M (23.9%); adjusted EPS $2.07 (+19%); GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations $0.43 after $25.9M of Brewing charges and $38.7M of equity losses from the Residential affiliate; FCF $116.8M.
FY2026 outlook raised: net sales $2,519-2,534M, organic growth 7.5%, adjusted EBITDA $589-593M, adjusted EPS $7.13-7.29.
Buybacks: 1.0M shares for $106.5M in Q3; 4.8M shares (9.7% of shares outstanding) in the first nine months.
CEO Tim FitzGerald steps down March 31, 2027; Steven Spittle (Chief Commercial Officer) becomes President now and CEO April 1, 2027.
New five-year $3.0B secured credit agreement (November 4, 2026): $2.0B revolver and $1.0B term loan A.

Derived, not reported: scenario free cash flow of about $280M (bear) and $350M (base) a year, about 50% and 55% of adjusted EBITDA against 54.5% in the first nine months of 2026 ($239.9M / $439.8M). Nine-month FCF per diluted share $5.24 (2025: $5.22).
